title: Decoupling of the STIRAP and Microwave-Dressing paths in Trapped Rydberg Ion Gates
summary: The strong dipole-dipole interaction of trapped Rydberg ions offers the possibility of sub-microsecond entanglement gates. For example a two-qubit Control-Phase gate in 88 Sr + ions can be realized, by simultaneous excitation to the Rydberg states via stimulated Raman adiabatic passage (STIRAP) with simultaneous microwave induced dipole-dipole interaction. We show that this excitation protocol distorts the dark-state of the STIRAP stage and is prone to decay from the intermediate state.
